Snapshot restore tiles, seccomp policies, parsers, and build rules.

## Folders
- **[generated](generated/README.md)**: Generated seccomp BPF filters for syscall and file descriptor checks.
- **[utils](utils/README.md)**: Snapshot restore parsers, peer selection, HTTP resolution, and test and fuzz harnesses.

## Files
- **[fd_snapct_tile.c](fd_snapct_tile.c.md)**: Snapshot restore tile that selects peers, downloads or reads snapshots, and manages gossip.
- **[fd_snapct_tile.h](fd_snapct_tile.h.md)**: Snapshot restore state constants, state-to-string mapping, and update metadata.
- **[fd_snapct_tile.seccomppolicy](fd_snapct_tile.seccomppolicy.md)**: Seccomp policy for snapshot restore logging, network, file, and shutdown syscalls.
- **[fd_snapdc_tile.c](fd_snapdc_tile.c.md)**: State machine for decompressing snapshot data and forwarding control and data fragments.
- **[fd_snapdc_tile.seccomppolicy](fd_snapdc_tile.seccomppolicy.md)**: Security policy for logging writes, logfile fsync, and exit on shutdown.
- **[fd_snapin_tile.c](fd_snapin_tile.c.md)**: Snapshot restore tile that parses manifests, loads accounts, and rebuilds txncache state.
- **[fd_snapin_tile.seccomppolicy](fd_snapin_tile.seccomppolicy.md)**: Security policy for logging writes, logfile fsync, and exit on shutdown.
- **[fd_snapld_tile.c](fd_snapld_tile.c.md)**: Loads snapshot data from local files or HTTP/TCP and forwards it for decompression.
- **[fd_snapld_tile.seccomppolicy](fd_snapld_tile.seccomppolicy.md)**: Seccomp policy for snapshot loading, logging, socket I/O, and shutdown.
- **[Local.mk](Local.mk.md)**: Build rules for restore tiles, utilities, unit tests, and fuzz tests.
